tagline_ja: 朝のラッシュ、ドアが閉まるまであと数秒。全員、押し込め！
tagline_en: Rush hour. Seconds until the doors shut. Cram. Them. All. In.
how_to_play_ja: ホームに並ぶ乗客を、先頭から1人ずつスワイプして車内へはじき入れます（引っぱった向きと長さで飛ぶ方向と強さが決まり、点線が止まる位置の目安）。発車ベルが鳴るとドアが1.2秒で閉まり、そのときドアの線にかかっている人はカバンや服のすそを挟まれてライフを1つ失います。ホームに残った人は乗り残し（ライフは減らないが連続ボーナスが途切れる。ただし1人も乗せられないとライフを1つ失う）。ドアを長押しすると押し屋が登場し、ドア付近の乗客を車内へ押し込みつつ全員を少しだけ縮めます。ただし押し屋はスタミナを消費し、車内の圧力が赤ゾーンに1秒とどまると窓が割れて乗客がホームのクッションへ飛び出し、ライフを失います。駅が進むごとに乗客が増え、発車までの時間が短くなり、硬い荷物の客、おすもうさん、せまい急行車両、反対側のドアが登場。スコアは乗せた人数×圧力ボーナス、全員乗車で駅クリアボーナス。発車中はタップで集計を飛ばせます。
how_to_play_en: Passengers queue on the platform. Swipe from the front passenger to flick them into the car; the swipe's direction and length set the launch, and the dotted line shows where they will stop. When the departure chime plays, the doors slide shut over 1.2 s, and anyone straddling the door line gets their bag or coat caught, costing one of 3 lives. Anyone still on the platform is left behind, which breaks your streak (it costs no life, unless nobody at all got on at that station). Hold the door to call the oshiya: a strong shove that pushes riders inward and squeezes everyone up to 15% smaller. Shoving drains stamina, though, and if the car's pressure stays in the red for 1 second a window pops and a rider bounces out onto a safety cushion on the platform, which also costs a life. Each station brings more passengers and less time, plus hard luggage that won't squish, a sumo wrestler, a narrow express car, and finally a second door on the far side. You score passengers boarded × the pressure bonus, plus a station-clear bonus whenever everyone gets aboard. Tap while the train pulls out to skip the tally.
controls: swipe/drag the front passenger to flick
tap while departing to skip the tally
video_hook_ja: 満員電車に、あと1人。押し屋の本気、見せてやる。
